stem: In a circle, m(arc BAD) = $240^\circ$. Set the inscribed angle ∠BCD that faces arc BAD, so that it shows $m(\angle BCD)$.
solution: ∠BCD is an inscribed angle facing arc BAD.
An inscribed angle is half the arc it faces.

hints.text: Check what you set: the inscribed angle is not equal to its arc, it is a fraction of it.
Check which arc ∠BCD faces; C faces the arc across from it.
Use the relation between the inscribed angle and the arc it faces.
